record.result: I added `TaskStore.paginate(offset=0, limit=10)` in `src/tasklib/store.py`. It returns a new list slice of the stored tasks in creation order, including completed ones. The same task objects are returned, not copies. A zero limit, or an offset past the end, gives `[]`. Offset and limit must be nonnegative ints; bools, other types and negatives raise `ValueError`. It only reads the store, so tasks, order and the next-ID counter don't change. The visible tests pass (127). I didn't add tests for `paginate`, since I can't edit test files.
